### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the address-family-aware DNS resolution changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Updates the opt-in `DnsAddressResolver` to honor the address family configured on its `DnsEndPoint`, matching the default broker DNS resolution behavior. **Changes:** - Filters DNS results by IPv4 or IPv6 when a specific address family is configured. - Preserves selection from all DNS results for unspecified address families. - Reports `SocketError.NoData` when no DNS result matches the requested family. - Adds xUnit coverage for address-family selection, port preservation, unspecified families, and unavailable-family scenarios. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | Tests/​DnsAddressResolverTests.cs | Adds regression coverage for family-aware DNS resolution, port preservation, unspecified families, and no-data errors. | | RabbitMQ.Stream.Client/​DnsAddressResolver.cs | Filters DNS results by the endpoint address family and handles cases with no compatible results. |
Review effort: Lite
